text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan!
An earth-shatteringly huge emergency has occurred, YEEES?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please stay calm and listen.
The truth is..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El got a fan letter, desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, your reaction is pretty subdued, desu.
You received a fan letter, you know, desu?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words!
El has gotten even stronger, you see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My papa told me a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A wrestler grows stronger with every fan they have...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El isn't a wrestler, but now, I finally understand what that means...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When El read those fan letters,
her soul ignited with fiery passion!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The voices of everyone cheering for El turned into flames and set El's soul on fire, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So this is the true nature of the strength Dad was talking about!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! El will keep growing stronger
together with my fans desu!

The fan letters seemed to have
stirred up her passion.
